t: What this life is called, in four words
a: وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ ۖ وَلَلدَّارُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يَتَّقُونَ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
p: Wa ma-l-ḥayātu-d-dunyā illā laʿibun wa lahw, wa la-d-dāru-l-ākhiratu khayrun li-lladhīna yattaqūn…
m: And the worldly life is not but amusement and diversion; but the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh, so will you not reason?
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
